title: MAT-4 — orchestrator persisted state (queue, artifacts, checkpoints)
description: Single JSON document shape for durable orchestrator state: ordered work queue, artifact index with repo-relative paths, and session checkpoints. Paths follow MAT-9 repo-relative rules; prefer prefixes from `repo.path_overrides.artifacts_dir` and `agent_state_dir` when present in the repo profile.
notes: Absolute `repo_root` is never embedded; consumers join paths with the same absolute root used for MAT-1 / MAT-2 requests.
Queue `work_item.adapter` values align with MAT-9 `work_item_source.adapter` discriminants.
Checkpoint `session` mirrors optional MAT-2 request `session` (session_id + turn) for cross-wiring.
MAT-10: optional top-level `orchestrator_session` (primary Claude Code session) and optional checkpoint `fluency` (planning/review phases, insights surface) for fluency tooling.
MAT-98: optional `token_budget` / `cost_budget` (and usage counters) on `orchestrator_session` and `queue.items[]`; terminal status `budget_exceeded`; optional `meta.transitions` audit log.
